helpTake: take / t <idx> [table... dDECL...]  capture (d0 is declaration 0)
helpLay: lay / l2 <idx>            lay the card on the table
helpNextRound: nextround / nr            go to the next round
helpLog: log / l                   show the action log
helpExampleTake: take 0 1 2                play hand card 0 and take table cards 1 and 2
helpExampleDeclare: declare 0 7 1             declare 7 with hand card 0 and table card 1
commandHint: take <idx> [table... dDECL...] to capture / declare <idx> <value> [...] / lay <idx> to lay off
nextRoundHint: Type nextround to start the next round.
reason.declare: declares a pile you can take later
reason.trail: nothing to take, so lay the card off
reason.none: no move to recommend right now
noHint: No move to recommend right now.
errNotPlayPhase: You cannot play a card in this phase.
errFaceMustCapture: A face card of the same rank is on the table, so this one cannot be laid off - capture it instead.
errMustAnswerDeclaration: You cannot lay off while you owe a declaration - capture it first.
errFaceCannotDeclare: Face cards cannot be used in a declaration.
errIndexRange: One of the indices is out of range.
errOneDeclarationAtATime: You can name at most one declaration at a time.
errNoBackingCard: You are not holding a card worth {{val}}, so you cannot declare it.
errFaceInDeclaration: Face cards cannot be mixed into a declaration.
errDeclarationSum: The total {{sum}} does not match the declared value {{val}}.
errGroupCannotBeRaised: A group declaration cannot be raised.
errKeepBackingCard: You must keep a card worth {{val}} to capture your own declaration.
